turns.text: Make a 4:5 poster with a burnt-orange background, cream lettering and a simple cream crescent moon. Text: 'NIGHT MARKET' and 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'. Bold, clean, no other words. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do this?
turns.agent:
**The cheapest option is a 0-credit SVG poster**—no AI generation needed. It preserves your exact wording and 4:5 shape, and stays sharp at any size.

Magic Hour’s lowest-cost image models start at **5 credits per image at 640px**. Smaller output won’t lower that starting price, and “shorter” doesn’t apply to a still poster. **I haven’t run any tools or spent any credits.**

Here’s your free poster. Save this as **`night-market.svg`** and open it in a browser or design app:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="800" height="1000" viewBox="0 0 800 1000">
  <title>Night Market — Saturday 6–10 PM</title>

  <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="#B84E2B"/>

  <!-- Simple cream crescent moon -->
  <defs>
    <mask id="crescent">
      <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="447" cy="292" r="108" fill="black"/>
    </mask>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="400" cy="330" r="120"
          fill="#FFF0D4" mask="url(#crescent)"/>

  <g fill="#FFF0D4" text-anchor="middle"
     font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-weight="900">
    <text x="400" y="605" font-size="80"
          letter-spacing="1">NIGHT MARKET</text>
    <text x="400" y="690" font-size="36"
          letter-spacing="3">SATURDAY 6–10 PM</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```
